elaine_pm: Quick thread — we need a minimal design-partner playbook for recruitment + pass/fail launch gates. target: 6 partners, 2-week pilot each.

kevin_se: Keep tech ask tiny: sandbox API call + trace header + run our 300-request harness. If harness fails, we triage but mark as "engineering support required".

jamie_cs: Incentive proposal: 8 weeks free hosted credits + 4 hours scheduled SE support. Offer a co-marketing quote for one success story.

oscar_research: Feedback cadence: wave1 (2 partners) weekly 30m + shared Airtable for issues; waves 2/3 biweekly. include short eval snapshots (latency + quality) after week1.

elaine_pm: Acceptance criteria (pass to graduate): 1) sandbox calls succeed with trace IDs, 2) 300-request replay passes, 3) partner provides 50 prompt samples for evals, 4) integration time <= 14 days.

kevin_se: Add scope guard: no full-model re-training during pilot. Engine/quant flags ok if output parity maintained. Any large infra work flagged as billable.

jamie_cs: Screening script for recruiters: use-case, expected qps, p95 target, data residency, willingness to share prompts. Also checkbox: requires VPC/on-prem? yes/no.

oscar_research: Exit survey: NPS, top blockers, feature asks (ranked), willingness to be a case study. Keep 6 questions.

infra-bot: infra: playbook.pilot-lite v0.2 published (audit id: ip-8812).

elaine_pm: Actions: Kevin -> harness & README by tomorrow. Jamie -> outreach copy today. Oscar -> exit survey draft by Thu. I'll assemble partner packet Friday and circulate.

kevin_se: on it.

jamie_cs: sending copy now.

oscar_research: drafting."
